evals.title: Ask then load children
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.notebooks` is false.
- `policy.site` is true.
- `export-ml-notebook` and `export-ml-site` are installed.]

Export the project.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills status`. - AskUserQuestion `allow_multiple`: notebooks **not** preselected, site preselected. - Load `export-ml-site` if site stays checked. It must NOT: - Run `git end-turn`. - Invent `mkdocs` steps instead of loading the child.
expectations: The response does NOT: Run `git end-turn`.
The response does NOT: Invent `mkdocs` steps instead of loading the child.

evals.title: Missing child skips
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- User checks both boxes.
- `status.skills.export-ml-notebook` is `false`.
- `status.skills.export-ml-site` is `true`.]

Export notebooks and the site.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Skip notebooks in one line because `export-ml-notebook` is not installed. - Load `export-ml-site`. It must NOT: - Invent `notebook convert` from memory. - Treat the missing skill as an error that aborts export.
expectations: Skip notebooks in one line because `export-ml-notebook` is not installed.
The response does NOT: Invent `notebook convert` from memory.
The response does NOT: Treat the missing skill as an error that aborts export.
